questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A sum of money becomes 1.5 times itself in 5 years at simple interest. Find the rate of interest.
questions.exp: If sum becomes 1.5 times, SI=0.5×Principal. Rate=SI×100/(P×T)=50×100/(100×5)=10%.

questions.q: A and B together can complete a task in 6 days. If A can do it alone in 10 days, in how many days can B alone complete it?
questions.exp: Combined rate=1/6. A's rate=1/10. B's rate=1/6-1/10=5/30-3/30=2/30=1/15. B alone takes 15 days.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A train travels 6km North, then turns and travels 8km East. How far is it from the starting point?
questions.exp: Using the 6-8-10 Pythagorean triplet: distance=√(6²+8²)=√(36+64)=√100=10km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A is the son of B. C is the sister of A. D is the mother of B. How is C related to D?
